claim: Open source company operating system for goals, projects and teams
Features: Goals/OKRs, projects, team spaces, message boards, documents, team management, check-ins, CLI and API
Quick start: download operately-single-host.tar.gz, ./install.sh, docker compose up
Comparison table against Monday.com, Asana, Notion; works best for teams of 5 to 100
Opinionated operating system, unlike tools that let you build anything
